topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 37 project-authored contract(s) across 5 chain(s); 11 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 6 functional families. Its contracts share 5 common project-authored base contract(s) (xerc4626, erc20burnable, erc20minterwithdrawal). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
